experiments.title: Source-aware reward-scale and hypervolume-reference calibration
experiments.notes: V1 failed closed on sparse Minecart returns. Source-aware v2 then passed using an independent fixed-pool LunarLander pilot and a deterministic versioned Minecart environment reference front. Both course protocols now contain frozen scales/reference points with hashed evidence; no final-test data was accessed.

experiments.title: Paired-seed controls and allocation-signal ablations
experiments.notes: Frozen as 150 paired jobs across two environments and five seeds. The 30-job primary PCQN block (uniform, matched-random, and full) completed on 2026-10-16 with zero executor failures and all final-checkpoint hashes verified. Validation aggregation and checkpoint locking are pending; 100 signal/target PCQN jobs and 20 qualified baseline jobs remain. Final-test evaluation stays locked and no comparative claim has been promoted.
